rejected_candidates.reason: These are problem definitions and algorithm specifications rather than finite proved conclusions.

rejected_candidates.candidate: the sketch-and-solve residual estimate in section 2.1.1
rejected_candidates.reason: The estimate is explicitly recalled from prior work and is not proved in this paper.
The standard matrix multiplication, Householder QR, and triangular-solve error bounds are quoted from Higham's textbook as background.
Its proof is an immediate parameter substitution into an external smoothed-analysis theorem.
It is retained as the computed-preconditioner provenance for P07-T1, but its own two condition-number bounds are not separately selected as a target.

These long bounds combine multiple floating-point black boxes, pseudoinverse norms, dimension-dependent constants, and asymptotic interpretation; their compositional deterministic core is better isolated by P07-T1 and P07-T2.

rejected_candidates.candidate: the full numerical conclusion of Theorem 3.5
rejected_candidates.reason: The final constants 6.04 and 2.01 depend on the preceding Theorem 3.4 estimates. P07-T2 selects the earlier unnumbered result in the proof, while retaining its full Algorithm 1.3 linkage, perturbed least-squares relation, exact four-term DeltaA, and fixed n/sqrt(n)/gamma_n estimate.
Both depend on Corollary 2.2's delegated Gaussian condition-number result; Theorem 4.2 additionally invokes an external Gaussian spectral-norm tail bound.
Experimental observations, plots, and implementation recommendations are not formal benchmark targets.

T1.decision: Use all of Lemma 3.2: the full-rank conclusion and its complete quantitative condition-number bound for the finite-precision forward-substitution output.

T2.decision: Use the algorithm-linked exact four-term backward-error construction and immediate fixed-coefficient spectral estimate in the proof of Theorem 3.5.

T3.decision: Use Lemma 2.1's condition-number identity as an exact reciprocal lower/upper certificate equivalence.

selection_policy: Use a finite claim made and proved in this paper.
Reject experiments, vague asymptotics, and claims whose proof is mainly delegated elsewhere.
Prefer exact displayed bounds and identities.
Keep the fixed Lean setting condition-neutral and paper-scoped.
Assign tiers only after verified frozen-library searches.
